roomSummary: Open-plan living and dining room with dark carpeting leading to a rear kitchen, featuring a prominent TV bracket on the right wall.
camera: Stands in the front-left foreground of the living area, looking diagonally toward the rear kitchen and right wall.

landmarks.description: Black TV wall bracket mounted on the right white wall
White kitchen peninsula counter facing the main room
Large window with beige curtains along the left wall
Wall-mounted heat pump unit high on the wall above the kitchen boundary
Full-height curtain hanging on the far-left foreground edge
Interior door beside the kitchen on the right

walls.name: Right wall
walls.description: White wall in foreground and midground featuring the mounted TV bracket

walls.name: Left wall
walls.description: Long wall with a wide window, curtains, and heat pump unit towards the rear

walls.name: Rear kitchen wall
walls.description: Back wall containing kitchen cabinetry and window
